heading: What we buy, and what we pass on.
lede: A clear box saves everyone time. Brokers and sellers who know the box send us the right deals.

columns.title: We buy
items: Ohio: Columbus, Cincinnati, Dayton, Cleveland metros
Under-managed, with a measurable rent-to-market gap
Adaptive-reuse buildings suited to residential conversion
Residential development sites, entitled or entitlable

columns.title: We pass
items: Deals priced on projected rents we cannot evidence today
Structural work we cannot scope before closing
Markets where we have no operating presence

columns.title: Underwriting standard
items: Stabilized value less capex sets the offer
Market and stabilized cap rates both tested
Debt sized to service in the downside case
No rent growth assumed in year one
Exit cap no tighter than entry implies
